results.title: Analysis Result
results.callEmergency: Call your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department now.

redFlags.heart_attack: Chest pain with breathlessness, sweating or a racing heart can signal a heart attack.
redFlags.stroke: Sudden weakness on one side or slurred speech can be signs of a stroke.
redFlags.consciousness: Confusion or reduced consciousness needs immediate medical care.
redFlags.meningitis: High fever with a stiff neck can indicate meningitis.
redFlags.liver_failure: Signs of acute liver failure need immediate medical care.
redFlags.bleeding: Bleeding (in stool, vomit or sputum) should be checked by a doctor promptly.
redFlags.lung_infection: Breathlessness with high fever can indicate a serious lung infection.
redFlags.jaundice: Yellowing of the skin or eyes suggests a liver problem and should be assessed.
